lines.text: She called me out for being late.

data.define: To say publicly that someone did something wrong.

example.text: She called me out for being late.

misuse.text: Don't 'call out' a coworker in front of the boss.

data.l1_hook: Sie hat allen meinen Fehler gezeigt! \"call out\"
data.l1_ex: Sie hat mich dafür kritisiert („called me out“), dass ich zu spät war.

native.tip: “call out” = öffentlich kritisieren. Beispiel: “She called me out for being late.”
